scope: Numerical control of the ONE truncation v44 could not quantify post hoc: FAC stores level eigenvectors only for |mix| >= 1e-5*|principal| and renormalises (AddToLevels, structure.c:3039). Re-run the sealed v41 ground_coherent100 and equal_coherent100 models, both gauges (4 native processes), with SetMixCut(0) inserted immediately before Structure, so every Hamiltonian component is stored and none renormalised. coherent100 is the tighter of the two v41 numerical controls; B and C share an identical CI. No new SCF, orbitals, configurations, Hamiltonian, expansion, lifetime adoption or grade.
source_basis: mix_cut is read ONLY at structure.c:3039 (stored-level truncation); mix_cut2 only acts with group filters and keeps its default 1.0 (SetMixCut second argument omitted). |mix|<0 is never true, so all components are stored, n_basis equals the Hamiltonian dimension and the renormalisation branch is not taken. ANGZCUT=1e-8 then becomes the only truncation, and the v44 component records flag and quantify every term it drops.
guards: Canary: rebuilt frontend on UNCHANGED v41 input reproduces every stable v41 file byte-for-byte. Each case: declared input = v44 input + one SetMixCut(0) line before Structure. Radial preflight, post-CI orbitals, potential and configuration state must equal the qualified v41 CI; o.lev level energies and labels identical except the session stamp; every stable v41 file byte-identical EXCEPT the declared consequences o.basis, o_export_000.cm (printed/exported mixing) and raw.tsv (rates). The coefficient transport is re-derived and recorded; the independent rate audit runs and is recorded, not compared. All v44 component identities (exact native amplitude, products, flags, radial cache, summation bound) must hold.
analysis: Per channel and gauge: amplitude and rate change vs v44/v41, stored vs Hamiltonian basis counts, the amplitude of terms now newly present, the angular-cut-dropped amplitude, and configuration-pair shifts, especially the 2p3 3p <- 2p3 3s channel. No gauge selection, energy rescaling or calibrated uncertainty.
resource_policy: Sirius only, sequential, single-thread, nice19; 180s build, 1800s per owned native group. Stop and preserve the first failure. Fresh directories; FAC source/library/executables and sealed v41/v43/v44 runs unmodified.
evidence: Lossless <=5MiB parts. Files byte-identical to the committed v41 archive, or to another file of this archive, are manifest-pinned references (v3); the full-eigenvector o.basis/.cm are stored once per model (B and C share the CI).
